clips.title: The story
paras: Cliffwatcher Longhorn tasks Horde champions with infiltrating Darkcloud Pinnacle to discover what the elusive Grimtotem clan is plotting. Three unknown couriers were spotted visiting the mesa, leaving guarded correspondence scattered across their mountaintop village. Uncovering these secret notes exposes a brewing scheme that threatens the tauren settlements of Thousand Needles.

Freewind Post sits precariously on high spires, but its defenders must constantly look over their shoulders at their hostile cousins. The Grimtotem clan has long maintained a tense, resentful stance toward the Horde, clinging to their isolationist strongholds atop Darkcloud Pinnacle. Cliffwatcher Longhorn noticed a shift in their behavior when three mysterious agents arrived over successive weeks, conferring with clan leadership in secret. Longhorn suspects these emissaries carried marching orders or alliances meant to undermine Thunder Bluff's presence in the canyon.

Darkcloud Pinnacle is a fortified network of sheer mesas connected by wooden rope bridges. Penetrating the village requires braving dense patrols of hostile Grimtotem warriors and shamans. Longhorn's scouts confirmed that the mysterious messages were locked away in separate chests spread across the outpost's central dwellings and outer bluffs. Securing the three secret notes requires sneaking or fighting across the entire settlement to snatch the clan's private communications from under their watchful eyes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.
Friend, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.
Friend, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
